vitiligo.india: Common and carries heavy stigma; early treatment helps.
vitiligo.dark_skin: Chalk-white patches in striking contrast. Distinguish from lighter (hypopigmented, not white) patches of leprosy, pityriasis versicolor, pityriasis alba and post-inflammatory change.
refer_if: Face and hands, for early therapy
ask: Are the patches completely white or just lighter?
Is sensation normal in the patch?
Any family history of vitiligo or thyroid disease?

tell_apart.cue: Pityriasis versicolor has fine scale and is lighter, not white

viral_infection.contagious: Often (chickenpox, hand-foot-mouth, herpes, molluscum, warts, mpox)
viral_infection.india: Chickenpox, hand-foot-mouth disease, herpes zoster, warts, molluscum and measles are common; mpox outbreaks occur.
viral_infection.dark_skin: Vesicles and rashes may look grey or dark; leaves pigmentation.
confirm: Morphology: grouped blisters in one band (zoster), umbilicated papules (molluscum), rough papules (warts)
refer_if: Zoster around the eye or tip of the nose: urgent (eye involvement)
Immunocompromised, pregnant or newborn patient with chickenpox
first_steps: Zoster: antiviral early (within 72 hours) by clinician
ask: Anyone else sick at home or school?
Is the rash in one band on one side of the body?

tell_apart.cue: Drug eruptions follow a new drug without sick contacts
Scabies itches at night with burrows

bkl.india: Seborrhoeic keratoses and dermatosis papulosa nigra (many small dark papules on the cheeks) are very common in Indian and darker skin.
bkl.dark_skin: Dermatosis papulosa nigra: multiple small, dark, stuck-on papules on the face, benign.
confirm: Dermoscopy: milia-like cysts, comedo-like openings, fissures
refer_if: Sudden eruption of many new lesions
A single lesion that looks different or bleeds
ask: Are there many similar spots that appeared slowly over years?

tell_apart.cue: Melanoma lacks milia-like cysts and changes over months
Actinic keratosis is rough and flat, not stuck-on

autoimmune_systemic.india: Includes cutaneous and systemic lupus, scleroderma, dermatomyositis and vasculitis.
autoimmune_systemic.dark_skin: Discoid lupus leaves marked light and dark pigment change and scarring; the malar rash looks less red.
confirm: Ask about joint pain, fever, mouth ulcers, Raynaud's, muscle weakness
ask: Joint pains, fever or mouth ulcers?
Fingers turning white or blue in the cold?

tell_apart.cue: Psoriasis has thick silvery scale and no scarring
Lichen planus is violaceous with Wickham's striae

scc.india: Often arises in chronic ulcers, burn scars, old lichen planus or lupus scars, and with arsenic exposure (e.g. contaminated groundwater).
scc.dark_skin: In darker skin SCC more often starts in scars and chronic wounds and on sun-protected sites, and tends to present late.
refer_if: Fast-growing, tender, crusted or keratotic nodule: urgent
An ulcer that develops in an old scar or burn
first_steps: Refer urgently for biopsy and excision
ask: Did it start in an old scar, burn or long-standing ulcer?
Any exposure to arsenic, tobacco or betel?

tell_apart.cue: Actinic keratosis is flat, rough and not tender
BCC is pearly with arborising vessels and grows slowly
